description: This file contains validation functions for various forms in a React frontend application related to quality defect management. It includes validators for defect creation, corrective actions, and 5-Why root cause analysis forms.

methods.name: validateDefect(values)
methods.description: Validates input values for defect creation form, checking for required fields and constraints like maximum title length.

methods.name: validateAction(values)
methods.description: Validates input values for corrective action form, ensuring essential fields like defect, title, owner, and due date are provided.

methods.name: validateRca(values)
methods.description: Validates input for 5-Why root cause analysis form, requiring at least 3 'Why' steps and a root cause summary.
